verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
[✲]By the heaven having mansions of stars,
And by the Promised Day,
[✲]And by the Witness and that about whom witness has been borne,
w: and that about whom witness has been borne

verses.en: [✲]Cursed be the Fellows of the Trench —
The fire fed with fuel —
As they sat by it,

verses.ar: وَّہُمۡ عَلٰی مَا یَفۡعَلُوۡنَ بِالۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ شُہُوۡدٌ ؕ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: And they witnessed what they did to the believers.

verses.ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوۡا مِنۡہُمۡ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ یُّؤۡمِنُوۡا بِاللّٰہِ الۡعَزِیۡزِ الۡحَمِیۡدِ ۙ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: And they hated them not but because they believed in Allah, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy,

verses.ar: الَّذِیۡ لَہٗ مُلۡکُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ ؕ وَاللّٰہُ عَلٰی کُلِّ شَیۡءٍ شَہِیۡدٌ ؕ﴿۱۰﴾
verses.en: To Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is Witness over all things.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِیۡنَ فَتَنُوا الۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ یَتُوۡبُوۡا فَلَہُمۡ عَذَابُ جَہَنَّمَ وَلَہُمۡ عَذَابُ الۡحَرِیۡقِ ﴿ؕ۱۱﴾
verses.en: Those who persecute the believing men and the believing women and then repent not, for them is surely the punishment of Hell, and for them is the punishment of burning.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَہُمۡ جَنّٰتٌ تَجۡرِیۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِہَا الۡاَنۡہٰرُ ۬ؕؑ ذٰلِکَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡکَبِیۡرُ ﴿ؕ۱۲﴾
verses.en: But those who believe and do good works, for them are Gardens through which streams flow. That is the great triumph.
Surely the seizing of thy Lord is severe.
[✲]He it is Who originates and reproduces;
And He is the Most Forgiving, the Loving;
The Lord of the Throne, the Lord of honour;
[✲]Doer of whatever He wills.
Has not the story of the hosts come to thee?
Of Pharaoh and Thamud?
Nay, but those who disbelieve persist in rejecting the truth.
[✲]And Allah encompasses them from before them and from behind them.
w: before them and from behind them

verses.en: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur’an,
In a well guarded tablet.
